explicit_source_layout.review: Native RGBA inspected on gray. Eight authored effect rows. Per-column vertical cuts follow irregular gaps, especially the tall third hellfire crown. Arrows share fixed shaft anchors; each later row retains fixed authored centers across its four stages. Source residual low-alpha pixels at reviewed boundaries are retained, never removed. The third whip/crown gap reaches alpha 36/255; this faint shared halo is split by the measured rectangle, with every source pixel assigned once. No visible opaque effect core is cut. One common anchored square and scale per animation preserves growth and extinction.

processing.method: Reviewed SHA-bound rectangles, byte-copy RGBA extraction, one common anchored square and scale per animation, Lanczos3 resampling, transparent padding and byte-copy atlas.
processing.orientation: Arrows authored pointing right, whip authored left to right; pipeline applies no rotation or mirror.
